Bug_Title: Eq: Covariant equals() method defined, Object.equals(Object) inherited (EQ_SELF_USE_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a covariant version of the equals()
method, but inherits the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class. 
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The class defines a covariant version of the equals() method, but inherits the normal equals(Object) method defined in the base java.lang.Object class. This can lead to unexpected results when comparing objects of this class with other objects or using the Object's equals() method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' compares an instance of CovariantEqualsBug with an instance of Object using the equals() method. Since CovariantEqualsBug does not override Object's equals(Object) method, the test case will fail, triggering the bug.
